owner_approval: Olesia (human-in-the-loop, required before any billing change, install, clone into a working folder, or code change)
purpose: Machine-readable ruleset for Hermes covering: (1) skill/tool substitution priority, (2) model/task routing across providers, (3) the human-only AI Studio prototyping handoff, (4) roster rules-file check, (5) Kanban board separation, (6) mandatory pre-install safety scan, (7) named third-party skill source to evaluate under the same rules.

step_0_substitution_rule.description: Applies before shortlisting any candidate skill/tool, including every item inside the named skill source below.
step_0_substitution_rule.check: For each candidate, determine if it links to, requires, or upsells a PAID product (subscription, paid API tier, paid starter kit, etc.).
step_0_substitution_rule.if_paid_detected: Actively search for a free/open-source equivalent OR check if the same job can be done with something already in use.
priority_order: 1. Something already in use / already subscribed to
3. New paid product — only if 1 and 2 genuinely cannot do the job, with written justification
step_0_substitution_rule.reporting_requirement: Report the substitution reasoning for every flagged item, even if the original paid one is ultimately recommended.

named_skill_source_to_evaluate.author: Michael Shimeles
named_skill_source_to_evaluate.note: Human-identified, not auto-discovered. No exemption from step_5_safety_rule. Some of this author's repos link to paid starter-kit products — apply step_0_substitution_rule to every individual skill found inside the repo, not just the repo as a whole.
named_skill_source_to_evaluate.output_required: List each relevant skill sub-path found inside the repo (e.g. .../skills/tree/main/code-structure), not just the repo root.

step_1_model_task_routing_rule.description: Mandatory. Applies to every task Hermes runs, not just installs. Never override without explicit human approval.

routes.why: Repetitive/unattended job; already free on existing runtime, no shared quota to protect.
Built for long-horizon agents/orchestration, 1M context, free.
Code never leaves the MacBook; no API key, no cost.

routes.task: Design copy / copywriting / SEO-GEO content / light single-function code review
routes.constraint: Low-volume, occasional calls only. Confirm project shows usage tier 'Free' before every call.
routes.why: Fits comfortably within free daily request limits when not looped.

step_1_model_task_routing_rule.hard_rule: Never route high-volume, repetitive, or unattended jobs through the Gemini Free-tier API key. It has daily request limits that reset once per day and will be exhausted quickly by loops or batch jobs.

step_2_ai_studio_handoff.description: Human-only step. Hermes does not execute this step.
process: Olesia opens Google AI Studio in a browser and confirms the Pro badge is active.
Olesia drafts and iterates a prompt or function-calling schema in the Playground, using the Pro subscription's higher UI-only quota.
Olesia copies the finalized prompt text.
Olesia hands the finalized text to Hermes.
Hermes embeds that exact text in a normal Gemini API call on the Free usage tier — Hermes must NOT redesign or re-iterate the prompt itself.
step_2_ai_studio_handoff.why_this_matters: Google AI Pro/Ultra quota benefits apply only inside the AI Studio web interface, never to direct API key usage, which is billed and managed separately.

step_3_rules_file_check.instruction: Locate and read the general rules file that applies to the whole agent roster (e.g. HERMES.md, CLAUDE.md, or equivalent root-level rules file in this repo). Summarize any rule that restricts installs, network calls, credential handling, or unattended writes.
step_3_rules_file_check.if_missing: Tell Olesia explicitly instead of assuming there are no rules.

step_4_kanban_separation.rule: Do NOT add any card from this task to the existing LexFlow CRM build board. Cross-link only via a text tag (e.g. 'blocks: CRM-upgrade') — never merge the boards.
step_4_kanban_separation.confirmation_required: Confirm back the exact board name and column list created.

step_5_safety_rule.applies_to: Every dependency/skill proposed, whether from GitHub, a package manager, or the named_skill_source_to_evaluate above.
step_5_safety_rule.rule: Never download or run any third-party code before it has been scanned. Run the scanner against a throwaway shallow clone before cloning into any real project folder.
step_5_safety_rule.stop_condition: If the scan flags unexplained network calls, shell/OS execution, or obfuscated code, STOP and report it — do not proceed automatically.

for_each_tool_or_skill_report: Exact GitHub repo URL (and sub-path if inside a larger repo)
Exact local path it WOULD be cloned/installed to (do not create it yet)
Application Inspector scan summary from the throwaway temp clone
Which Kanban card (from step_4) this item is tracked under
Step 0 substitution verdict (already-have / free-alternative / new-paid + why)
Which model/provider (per step_1_model_task_routing_rule) this task should run on, and why

step_7_wait_for_approval.instruction: Present everything above to Olesia and her tutor for review before any real install, clone into a working folder, billing change, or code change happens.
